parole.testo: Borrowed from Venetan s-ciao, sciavo (“slave”) (in particular the expression s-ciao vostro (literally “(I am) your slave”), in essence meaning "I am at your service", or "your humble servant"), from Medieval Latin sclavus (“slave”) (whence also standard Italian schiavo); in the Venetan language orig

parole.significato: dogaressa, dogess (the wife of a doge)
parole.testo: Venetan dogaresa, from Medieval Latin ducarissa, from Latin ducatrix, from dux (“ruler”) + -issa (feminine suffix), with an additional infix. By surface analysis, doge + -essa. Doublet of duchessa.
